subpages.text: Home About About Us Careers News Medical Telecoms Laboratory NDT Equipment Projects Contact Tektraco is a Maltese Company established in 1990 by professional engineers and entrepreneurs who pooled together their considerable experience in doing business in Libya and Malta. Three distinct divisions were set-up as a natural continuation of their ongoing activities and these still form the core business of the company. TELECOM PROJECTS MEDICAL ENGINEERING LABORATORY SOLUTIONS Tektraco’s marketing efforts initially focused on two specific countries – MALTA and LIBYA. The island’s proximity to North Africa, the ease of travel to Libya and the very good relations existing between the two countries were all advantages which helped in no small way in building our business in these two markets. As a result of Tektraco’s professional approach to business the company now enjoys a very good reputation in both countries as well as beyond. In the last decade we in fact executed different projects, which included design, supply and installation of medical Gas systems in Oman, Tanzania & Albania. Philosophy and Mission Treat both Clients and Principals as its ‘Partners’, as we always aim to establish the right collaboration and deliver project success. Provide a safe and friendly working environment, and encourage personal and professional development for our staff. Innovation is our inspiration, as it is our goal to offer cutting edge technology to suit our client’s needs. Engage employees to embrace our Company’s social and environmental responsibilities. subpages.text: Home About About Us Careers News Medical Telecoms Laboratory NDT Equipment Projects Contact Tektraco specializes in providing high-quality laboratory solutions with decades of experience in the industry. We offer a range of services, including the supply, installation, and maintenance of cutting-edge laboratory equipment and systems. Our team is committed to delivering reliable and precise solutions tailored to the specific needs of research institutions, hospitals, and industrial labs. In addition to equipment supply, we excel in creating customized laboratory setups and ensuring their ongoing operational efficiency, helping our clients maintain top-tier research and testing environments. Over the years the product range has grown significantly so as to meet the requirements of the various industrial sectors, and today its portfolio includes: Labware & Chemicals Lab Furniture Analytical Equipment Petroleum testing Equipment Environmental Simulation Educational Equipment We have our own Service Department and also offer a number of value added services in the form of: Installation, training & commissioning, Corrective & Preventive maintenance, Lab design & infrastructure, Consultancy Courses Most of the above services are offered as an integral part of a sale or project, however some others such as maintenance agreements are also available on demand.
